mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing lithium clearance and reducing serum levels, while also increasing serotonergic activity elevating serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, monitor lithium levels closely and watch for decreased efficacy or serotonin syndrome symptoms; counsel patient to avoid herbal supplements without pharmacist/prescriber approval.
